---
title: "Exercise 0: Setup check"
description: "Complete this before the session."
---

::: {.callout-note}
Complete this **before the session**. It takes 20-30 minutes, mostly waiting for installs. If anything fails, note the error message and bring it along.
:::

## 1. Install the software

1. **Git**: <https://git-scm.com/downloads>. On Windows, accept all the defaults.
2. **R** (latest release): <https://cran.r-project.org/>
3. **RStudio** (<https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/>) or **Positron** (<https://positron.posit.co/>), or both. Both include Quarto.

## 2. Create a GitHub account and accept the invitation

1. Sign up at <https://github.com> if you don't have an account. Use your work email address.
2. Send your GitHub username to the facilitator.
3. You'll receive an email invitation to `harmonicr/acpcc_git_training`. Select **Accept invitation**.

## 3. Tell Git who you are

Run this once in the **R console** of either IDE, with your own details:

```r
install.packages(c("usethis", "gitcreds"))

usethis::use_git_config(
  user.name  = "Alex Smith",
  user.email = "alex.smith@example.org"   # the email on your GitHub account
)
```

## 4. Connect to GitHub

GitHub uses a personal access token (PAT) instead of a password. Still in the R console:

```r
usethis::create_github_token()
```

A GitHub page opens with the right settings selected. Add a note such as "ACPCC training", choose an expiry date, select **Generate token**, and copy the token. Then run:

```r
gitcreds::gitcreds_set()
```

and paste the token when asked. Git stores it in your operating system's credential store, so RStudio, Positron and the terminal all use it.

Check everything with:

```r
usethis::git_sitrep()
```

Look for your name, email and `Personal access token: <discovered>`.

## 5. Clone the repository

The repository URL is `https://github.com/harmonicr/acpcc_git_training.git`.

::: {.panel-tabset group="ide"}
## RStudio

1. *File → New Project... → Version Control → Git*
2. **Repository URL**: paste the URL above
3. **Create project as subdirectory of**: choose a folder you'll find again, such as `Documents/projects`
4. Select **Create Project**. RStudio opens the project and shows a **Git** tab in the top-right pane.

## Positron

1. *File → New Folder from Git...* (or **Clone Git Repository** on the Welcome page)
2. Paste the URL above and press Enter
3. Choose a parent folder you'll find again, such as `Documents/projects`
4. Positron opens the folder. The **Source Control** icon in the left Activity Bar shows the Git view.

## Terminal

```bash
cd ~/Documents/projects
git clone https://github.com/harmonicr/acpcc_git_training.git
cd acpcc_git_training
```
:::

## 6. Install the R packages and render one page

In the R console of the project:

```r
renv::restore()
```

Answer `y` when asked. This installs the exact package versions the project uses, which takes a few minutes the first time.

Then render the Summary page. In the **Terminal** tab (not the R console):

```bash
quarto render index.qmd
```

Open `_site/index.html` in a browser. You should see the report with a yellow "Training demo" banner.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Done

If `git_sitrep()` found your token and the page rendered, you're ready. See you at the session.
:::
